record.oneLiner: Google Ads API provides programmatic access to Google Ads accounts, campaigns and reporting.
record.verdictReason: Google's docs list OAuth 2.0 user flow and service account flow. Test access is granted on enabling the API, but production calls need an access-level application (Basic, then Standard for larger use); Google says Basic may be upgraded automatically on submission, so the approval step is light for Basic but a manual audit applies to Standard. Developer tokens were sunset on September 9, 2026 per Google's page. Google publishes an official Google Ads MCP server on GitHub.

evidence.quote: Both OAuth 2.0 user authentication flow and service account flow are supported.
Google may automatically upgrade your project's API access level to Basic once you submit your application.
The Google Ads API can be called either using gRPC or REST.
The Google Ads MCP server provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API.
